sn38.5:1.6: “But, reverend, what is the path and what is the practice for realizing this solace?”
sn38.5:1.7: “This, reverend, is the noble eightfold path for realizing this solace, that is—
sn38.5:1.9: This, reverend, is the path, this is the practice for realizing this solace.”
sn38.5:1.10: “This path is good, reverend, this practice is better, for realizing this solace.
sn38.5:1.11: And, reverend Sāriputta, don’t be heedless.”
